t: This is 102 Petty France, a fourteen-storey office block overlooking St James's Park. It stands fifty-six metres tall and was completed in 1976. Fitzroy Robinson and Partners designed it with Sir Basil Spence. Spence is the Scottish architect best known for Coventry Cathedral, and he worked widely in the Modernist and Brutalist style. From 1978 to 2004 this was the main home of the Home Office, then known as 50 Queen Anne's Gate. Today it houses the Ministry of Justice, the Crown Prosecution Service, the Government Legal Department and other bodies.
